meaning: What is this? Where did you put it?
notes: Short natural prompts after the user photographs an item. Do not speak the PutMind brand.

en-US.text: What is this? Where did you put it?

ja-JP.text: これは何ですか？どこに置きましたか？

de-DE.text: Was ist das? Wohin hast du es gelegt?

vi-VN.text: Đây là gì? Bạn để ở đâu?

fr-FR.text: Qu’est-ce que c’est ? Où l’avez-vous rangé ?

pt-BR.text: O que é isso? Onde você guardou?

zh-TW.text: 這是什麼？你放在哪裡了？
